item.title: Jarvis keeps himself at the top
item.description: Casey Jarvis shared the lead for the third straight day at the 2026 Magical Kenya Open as he and Angel Ayora went into the final round tied at 17 under par. Spaniard Ayora carded a six-under-par 64, his second of the week, but Jarvis’ 66 ensured he stayed locked at the top. item.title: Jarvis breaks through with first win in Kenya
item.description: Casey Jarvis won his maiden DP World Tour title as he rounded off a wire-to-wire success at the 2026 Magical Kenya Open presented by absa.
